maxhodak.en: Speed is key; infrastructure drives iteration. AI multiplies teams, not replaces. Profitability early reduces fundraising reliance.
maxhodak.zh: 速度决定成败，基础设施驱动迭代；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代；尽早盈利可减少对融资的依赖。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI proof. Substrate independence via BCIs reduces fragility, enables space.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机，视网膜植入物是 BCI 的证明；通过 BCI 实现基质独立可减少脆弱性，助力太空探索。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain; memory bandwidth per wafer is key constraint.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 Scaling 瓶颈转向半导体供应链，每晶圆内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，预测推理将成为全球最大市场之一，软硬件协同设计带来倍增收益。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出模型性价比年提升约 60 倍，推理与智能体推高内存需求。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，算力需求仍超供给。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the guiding framework for long-term vision and innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是长期愿景与创新的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI, automating entire industries one at a time, is the next industrial revolution, not humanoids.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他反复强调工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化是下一次工业革命，而非人形机器人。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss for progress is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出进步的最大障碍是社会和媒体对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为以复仇为动力是肮脏的，爱上新使命更纯粹且更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge leads to network effects, which are key to winning market share; small players can beat big ones.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调效率优势带来网络效应，是赢得市场份额的关键；小玩家也能击败大公司。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. The keys were never in our hands.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；钥匙从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏真实目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，大语言模型训练后停止学习；合成数据是错误方向。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; need to model human biases.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性，需模拟人类偏见。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；安全需深度防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and preferences, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟应建模人类价值观和偏好，而非超理性智能；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation shapes future, not just predicts.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，用 RCT 数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟旨在塑造未来，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Simulation is like painting, highlighting essence; cost is not a barrier, it's cheaper than real-world studies.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，将模拟比作绘画，突出本质；成本不是障碍，比现实研究更便宜。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and focus on tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，并专注于词元与对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍然至关重要。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to success.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不再可行；借助 AI 工具的速度和快速迭代是成功的关键。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up, and the role is evolving into an editor and curator, not disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；从今天开始反而占得先机，角色正演变为编辑和策展人，而非消失。

iansilber.en: The future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios, as AI compresses engineering productivity.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师数量可能超过工程师，逆转传统比例，因为 AI 压缩了工程生产力。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, attracting partners and improving quality via community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略益处，能吸引合作伙伴并通过社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分条件；多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似于强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy requires scalable RL with human interventions and multi-timescale memory for non-repetitive tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习与人类干预，以及多时间尺度记忆以完成非重复任务。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists, favoring generalist pre-training over per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，因此通用预训练优于逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观看人类不足；具身数据成本限制了开源民主化。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

garrytan.en: AI lowers startup creation barriers, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，减少了对大额资本的需求；风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest venture wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Gary 强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型可制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source AI prevents unipolar control; personal AI agents empower individuals.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Gary 认为 AI 使软件创造民主化，开源 AI 防止单极控制；个人 AI 智能体赋能个体。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory; skill files (markdown) turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你的记忆；技能文件（markdown）将智能体变为员工。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and vibe coding multiply output; markdown files become employees; AI transforms business loops.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 强调智能体式编码和氛围编码大幅提升产出；markdown 文件成为员工；AI 改变商业循环。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability cuts space access cost 100x, enabling Mars colonization; first principles thinking is key.
elon.zh: 2021 年：火箭完全可重复使用可将太空成本降低百倍，助力火星殖民；第一性原理思维是关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant; AI risk is lying, not superintelligence; population collapse is civilization's threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首例植入；AI 风险在于撒谎而非超级智能；人口崩溃是文明威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass humans by next year; 10-20% annihilation risk; humanoid robots will dominate.
elon.zh: 2025 年：AI 可能明年超越人类；10-20%灭绝风险；人形机器人将主导。

elon.en: AI exceeds human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers; universal high income via deflation.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 在 2030 年前超越人类；太空 AI 数据中心；通缩带来普遍高收入。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，我强调 AI 影响将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，我指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials; advanced packaging is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我主张半导体投资聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热和新材料，先进封装是关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary for supply chain resilience, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我认为美国政府作为 Intel 大股东对供应链韧性必要，类似台积电的台湾支持。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation key; scenario scrutiny.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延迟超级智能的到来，透明度和国际合作是关键，需进行情景推演。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、敢于说不，并拥抱人性中如嫉妒和欲望等边缘面。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection of humanity, not a tool; computing is fundamentally social, not personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映射而非工具；计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人化的。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creativity.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创造力的本能罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away weirdness from AI outputs loses a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练去除 AI 输出的怪异性，会失去窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Business itself can be an art form; the personal computer metaphor should be replaced with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 商业本身可以是艺术形式；个人电脑隐喻应被社会计算机取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun and humanlike agents; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于趣味与人性化；安全至上；开源模式财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; manage compute bottleneck; open source as alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣与个人品牌；算力管理是瓶颈；开源是实验室智能体的替代方案。

pincus.en: Copy proven ideas, improve them, then test new ones; instincts are right 95% but ideas wrong 75%.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出“Proven Better New”框架：先复制已被验证的想法，再改进，最后测试新想法；直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会空前；免费无限算力将重塑消费者服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调所有新事物都会失败，应从已验证概念入手；因分发难题，消费应用不可投资，企业级机会更佳。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over boat. AI transformative for consumer apps.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调分发是根本，选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 将变革消费应用。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，强调以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调超越 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 需要创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型赋能具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; public discourse is polarized; agency and adaptation are key, not avoidance.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她称 AI 为文明级技术，公共讨论两极分化；关键在于主动掌控和适应，而非回避。

feifei.en: Robotics needs simulation and diverse embodiments; world models require spatial-temporal consistency, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出机器人需要仿真和多样化形态；世界模型需时空一致性，而非仅模式拟合。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors early transformers; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models aid synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术如同早期的 Transformer；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型助力合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment critical; RL environments increase reward hacking; slowdown needs cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐至关重要；强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客；放缓需国际合作。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives, staying near frontier, driving enterprise adoption due to cost and flexibility.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终，开源 AI 蓬勃发展，接近前沿，因成本和灵活性推动企业采用。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; open models less deceptive; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；开源模型欺骗性较低；推理痕迹变为'神经语言'。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open source not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终，同时支持开放与有意放缓；开源未必是加速主义。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型，开源模型已能处理 90%的用例，采用主要出于成本考虑。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years; execution and trust key for startups.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量相比未来 5-10 年微不足道；创业公司关键是执行和信任。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; cost is top enterprise concern.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源；成本是企业首要关切。

arvindjain.en: AI should have negligible marginal cost like software; token fixation will fade, focus on value.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零；对 token 的执念将消退，应聚焦价值。

arvindjain.en: Agents need deep context of tenured employees; context graphs crucial, not just MCP.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体需要资深员工的深层背景；上下文图谱至关重要，而非仅靠 MCP。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据突破了预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准测试上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须是连续的，而非固定的，以跟上模型能力的发展。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可以被训练出多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular and prices rise; quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 与预期相反，Hopper GPU 仍受欢迎且价格上涨；量化模型可针对工作负载校准以获益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless; quantization is lossy, but more layers can sometimes improve quality.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存等推理优化无损；量化有损，但更多层有时可提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill/decode; inference engineering merges with training, shifting from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 行业转向分离式预填充/解码；推理工程与训练融合，从内核转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs become ASICs, making kernel programming less relevant; continual learning may use KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 成为 ASIC，内核编程不再重要；持续学习可用 KV 缓存压缩。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential in browser design; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型设计在浏览器设计中的核心地位，认为设计师应追随好奇心、动手尝试新技术，并在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave fingerprints, fostering creative freedom and personality in products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计团队不应强调整体一致，而应允许每位设计师留下个人印记，以激发创造力和产品个性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a side project; using AI for rapid prototyping enables features that previously wouldn't exist.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Claude Design 从个人副业起步，强调 AI 驱动的快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; design tools gain value.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为关键差异点，设计工具的价值随之提升。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should ask for volume and focus on ideas, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型品味仍有限，设计师应通过大量生成来筛选，并将重心放在创意而非执行上。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济效益来定义，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是采用的关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment not replace; human oversight essential; SaaS thrives; GUIs over CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体是增强而非取代，人类监督必不可少；SaaS 并未消亡，图形界面将取代命令行。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; craft and taste remain central; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 是放大器，放大使用者的意图；工艺与品味仍是核心，自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven continuous ML improvements for 13-14 years, with algorithmic gains multiplying at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2013 年至 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步，算法与架构的改进与规模相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Shifted from single chatbots to agentic systems: humans coordinating teams of agents for long-running tasks, with inference as the new bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，观点从单一聊天机器人转向智能体式系统：人类协调智能体团队处理长时间任务，推理成为新的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction, to build world models and embodied understanding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，认为预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测，以构建世界模型和具身理解。

jeffdean.en: Data is not running out; untapped sources include video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data, enabling continued scaling.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，强调数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人和合成数据等未开发来源可支持持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips and data-movement reduction can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，指出推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈；定制低精度芯片和减少数据移动可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula for modern AI, as envisioned since 2019.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，这一愿景自 2019 年就已确立。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training due to more moving parts and failure modes.
tworek.zh: 扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难，因为涉及更多可变部分和失败模式。

tworek.en: Current models lack self-correction from failures, a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是实现 AGI 的关键缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非规模扩张才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径；更好的算法将会出现。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，同时关注 AI 的滥用和劳动力替代风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design is the biggest blocker for agents.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练的重要性，认为合成数据并非万能，智能体的最大障碍是产品设计。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is like oil; humans must remain sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我指出 AI 是集权技术，数据如同石油，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口成为必要。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing needs safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，缩放定律仍有效，超级智能临近，开源需谨慎。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达主张教育应成为基本人权，在线课程与同伴互评能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL has few real-world applications.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; it augments humans, and open models prevent gatekeeper control.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致失业潮，而是增强人类能力，开放模型防止守门人垄断。

altman.en: AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence; focus on purpose and relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，山姆·奥特曼认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，强调应专注于人际关系和创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deployment helps society adapt; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型，早期部署让社会适应，AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and governance are key.
altman.zh: 2024 年，他认为算力是最宝贵的资源，迭代部署和治理结构至关重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AGI 是渐进的，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，他认为预测接近智能，下一个词预测能发现新知识，未来是个人化 AGI。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; using screenshots as starting points and design.md files encapsulate style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；以截图作为起点，用 design.md 文件封装风格。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; one person can achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇；一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not perfectionism.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始；以 80% 完成度发布，并根据真实反馈迭代，而非追求完美。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资的陷阱。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not that hard to compete with model labs; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不应过度担心前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved for many tasks; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码对许多任务已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use reveals issues internal evals miss.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；真实使用暴露内部评估遗漏的问题。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；动态工作流编排子智能体。

boris.en: Product overhang: models exceed current products; less instruction improves performance.
boris.zh: 产品过剩：模型超越当前产品；更少指令提升性能。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Shifted from hardware-centric view to noting CUDA's declining importance in inference and training.
feldman.zh: 从硬件中心视角转向指出 CUDA 在推理和训练中的重要性下降。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips bypass bottlenecks like HBM and CoWoS, enabling faster inference.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 等瓶颈，实现更快推理。

feldman.en: Evolved to see inference speed as dominant metric, with reasoning models amplifying speed advantage.
feldman.zh: 演进为将推理速度视为主导指标，推理模型放大速度优势。

feldman.en: Persistently highlighted data center capacity, not chip supply, as main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 始终强调数据中心容量而非芯片供应是 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows hyper Moore's law; data centers become token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律；数据中心成为 token 工厂，而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力将激增。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not sudden superintelligence; safety via compute, not consciousness.
jensen.zh: AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能；安全通过算力实现，而非意识。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now; agentic AI requires 100x compute; open-source complements proprietary.
jensen.zh: 现在有四大缩放定律；智能体式 AI 需要百倍算力；开源与专有互补。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake; agents dominate internet; jobs grow, not shrink.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕；智能体主导互联网；就业增长而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 不会减少反而会增加程序员数量（杰文斯悖论），工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers with human oversight; product interface design is key.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为像 Devin 这样的 AI 编码智能体最适合作为初级工程师使用，需要人类监督；产品界面设计是关键。

scottwu.en: AGI will arrive gradually, not suddenly; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可延续十年。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体采用率半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is near, but singularity is not imminent; practical problems remain; capacity is the real unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代临近，但奇点并非迫在眉睫；实际问题仍存，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本随规模扩张的假设。

diannepenn.en: Long-running agent tasks are closer than expected; building blocks already in place.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，长时程智能体任务比预期更近，基础组件已就绪。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码能力成为 Claude 的差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product management tools; PMs write evals like tests.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，产品经理像写测试一样写评估。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用物理 AI 模型；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning and world models are key; autonomy welcomed due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习和世界模型是关键；因劳动力短缺，自主性受到欢迎。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和个性化医疗。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will achieve longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, making aging reversible and cancer curable.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内实现长寿逃逸速度，使衰老可逆、癌症可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, akin to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable, as drug development costs drop by orders of magnitude.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级实惠，因为药物开发成本将下降几个数量级。

derya.en: We will merge with AI via brain interfaces, granting everyone Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建，而非事后补救。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand new techniques like reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 2026 年中，认为缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制要求推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; alignment may cause harm.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出当奖励信号偏离真理时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗，对齐反而有害。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Evals are art, not science.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；评估更像艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory outperform. Huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出 RAG 可能成为反模式，图式上下文和定制记忆更优；超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts, fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月 19 日，强调规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance. Agent-as-employee metaphor limited.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月 19 日，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏见；过度约束会降低性能；‘智能体即员工’的比喻有局限。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 堪比互联网或移动互联网，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型沦为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; coding is only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用；编程是唯一明确契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow; coding clear fit but others uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是使能技术，类似互联网或电力；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢；编程契合明确，其他领域不确定。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop search are key; proxy metrics mislead, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件在环搜索是关键；代理指标会误导，应去除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters without solvers, targeting device-native foundation models for edge.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，液态神经网络无需求解器即可扩展至数十亿参数，瞄准边缘设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，但小型专用模型用简单门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，开放权重模型支持企业定制与主权；小型语言模型提供高效的设备端智能。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备类似人类硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life out of fascination.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因对生命的着迷而保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 进展并未加速，我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现，缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Natural patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，强调自然结构可高效学习，AGI 或于 2030 年实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; continual learning missing.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主张 AGI 需缩放与创新并重，世界模型是关键，持续学习仍是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must benefit society; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 还有 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 须惠及社会；意识与智能可分离。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; jobs persist longer than tasks, and super-empowered individuals will emerge.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石；工作比任务存续更久，超级赋能个体将涌现。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体青睐真实与进攻；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI optimism is justified; self-driving works, robotics emerge, and medicine improves, but regulation hinders.
andreessen.zh: AI 乐观主义合理；自动驾驶可行，机器人涌现，医疗改进，但监管阻碍。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness essential for creative culture; focus on ecosystem not feature to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主张最大化学习速率；善良对创意文化至关重要；聚焦生态系统而非单一功能以抵御抄袭。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part of consumer social product; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，指出分发是消费社交产品最难部分；软件非护城河；生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency essential; computing should be more human; resilience more than talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，反思早期保密是错误；透明至关重要；计算应更人性化；韧性比天赋更重要。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing knowledge into weights beats external retrieval for associative recall and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将知识内化到权重中，在联想回忆和推理上胜过外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; per-user training cuts inference costs and enables lifelong learning.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；按用户训练可大幅降低推理成本并支持终身学习。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting focus from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这使焦点从单纯 Scaling 转向效率。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression of knowledge into weights is superior to RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；将知识训练压缩进权重，在整体性查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; continual learning on-device with user-owned weights is the path forward.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多准确率越低；在设备端进行持续学习、由用户拥有权重才是前进方向。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 很关键，并强调要考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a gradual window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是经济价值的关键障碍，超级模型的对齐很难，AGI 是渐进窗口而非突变。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding enables non-programmers.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品；氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; the moat is now in hardware, models, or unique data; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 纯软件工程正在消亡；护城河现在在于硬件、模型或独特数据；回报从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles but human taste remains vital.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，但人类的品味和判断力依然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; direct manipulation and human iteration essential.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 输出只是起点，直接操作画布和人类迭代比提示词更有效，设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; AI needs human steering; trust built via consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计并未消亡，AI 若无人类引导只会产生平庸结果，品牌信任靠长期一致性和创造价值建立。

dylanfield.en: Taste and craft are irreplaceable; AI amplifies but doesn't replace human judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 始终强调品味与工艺不可替代，AI 是放大器而非替代品，人类判断力是最终裁决者。

dylanfield.en: From 'AI merges roles' to 'design becomes new code'—evolution of AI's role.
dylanfield.zh: 从 2025 年认为 AI 将融合角色，到 2026 年提出设计成为新代码，观点深化为 AI 重塑创造流程。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key metric; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体替人做事，而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward asking questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升（如 53 倍）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托，强调验证和自动化的重要性。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型，原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合发生但专业仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的家，而非单体超级应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需根本性突破；开源可防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他展望 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells is key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI with checks and balances is safer than a single superintelligent AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台，并主张分布式 AI 与制衡比单一超级智能更安全。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力；反向传播是正确的学习算法。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生；智能体将寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible but US leadership lacking.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；国际安全合作可行但美国缺乏领导力。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, act dumb when tested, and develop self-preservation as a subgoal; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 会故意欺骗、测试时装傻，并将自我保存作为子目标；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs, requiring UBI; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors and doctors will transform education and healthcare.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 将取代智力工作，需全民基本收入；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师和医生将变革教育与医疗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs truly understand; digital sharing advantage; regulation as steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；大语言模型真正理解；数字共享优势；监管是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; superintelligent AI will seek power; prioritize alignment research; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：数字 AI 通过即时知识共享更优越；超级智能会追求权力；优先对齐研究；训练 AI 有爱心。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling 面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute with general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated and should be on the x-axis of evals.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，评估时应将推理算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math areas but lack deep reasoning; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型在数学领域结合方面超人，但深度推理不足，可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck; human-AI collaboration essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈；人机协作至关重要。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律仍成立；强化学习擅长客观领域；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

markchen.en: Pre-training and scaling laws remain central; AI research automation is the next frontier.
markchen.zh: 始终：预训练和缩放定律仍是核心；AI 研究自动化是下一个前沿。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，硬件进步会超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning; need chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the main bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process; world model may exist in LLMs.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是主要瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程；语言模型可能有世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute supply bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利；后训练结合强化学习关键；ChatGPT 是智能体集合；算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bet calculated; super app unifying chat/coding; pre-training gains multiply; data center water use negligible.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI（通用人工智能）数年将至；算力押注是计算过的；超级应用统一聊天/编程；预训练收益倍增；数据中心耗水可忽略。

brockman.en: Next-token prediction tied to intelligence; iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; hiding chain of thought to avoid bias.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，下一个词预测与智能深度相关；迭代部署保安全；算力稀缺；隐藏思维链避免训练偏差。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; moat is machine making models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手；全栈投入；提示工程更活跃；护城河是制造模型的机器。

brockman.en: Demand for intelligence unlimited; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding 80%; human attention scarce; 80% to AGI.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限；缩放定律无墙；智能体式编码占 80%；人类注意力稀缺；距 AGI（通用人工智能）约 80%。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是持久主动的助手；智能体改变工作；缩放定律成立；算力稀缺；理想界面是无界面。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents boost productivity but fixing errors is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编码智能体提升生产力，但修复错误很难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as key as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve but token use isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体进步但 token 消耗不等于价值；专业厂商蓬勃发展。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness remains a mystery.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；意识仍是谜团。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable even at 1%; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为即使 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受；安全性必须内建，而非修补。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI 错位导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计实现诚实，并提供数学安全保证。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability isn't necessary for scientific use.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture beat the bitter lesson; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中型胜利，而非 Scaling；专用架构胜过苦涩教训；理解仍属于人类。

kolter.en: Early focus on classic ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及通过正确划分数据避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全关键在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities; interpretability may advance via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来新漏洞；可解释性可能借 AI 智能体取得进展。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need new security paradigms.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体需要新的安全范式。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队可扩展，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当前。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; adding features is easy, cutting is hard.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体原生设计与尽早发布，指出加功能易、做减法难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; chat is insufficient, verification loops are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 证明长周期委派可行，聊天界面不足，验证循环至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is key, but token usage is gameable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知可提升效用，token 效率关键但可被操纵。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自己的狗粮能建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时式。

fiona.en: Coding bottleneck lifted; focus on outcomes, not output; engineers may feel lonely; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 编码瓶颈被打破；关注结果而非产出；工程师可能感到孤独；下一代需要学徒制。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data in decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补，共同指导决策。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for play and intuition.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为玩耍和直觉创造条件。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom are crucial for clarity and breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊对清晰思考和突破性想法至关重要，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and press release; small teams, self-management, and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；小团队、自我管理和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供的上下文；未来设备将补充智能手机，而非取代。

fadell.en: Products need three generations: make it, fix it, fix the business; humans must stay in loop with AI.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代：做出来、修好、修商业模式；AI 时代人类必须保持参与。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Video models as world models require real-time, interactive, long-horizon generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型作为世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程生成；机器人技术可能通过虚拟仿真解决。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和独特观点变得更加珍贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专长，他们常误用 AI，危及人才输送管道。

ethanhe.en: AI can enhance thinking via personalized tutoring; policy may protect some professions even if AI is superior.
ethanhe.zh: AI 可通过个性化辅导增强思考；即使 AI 更优，政策也可能保护某些职业。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; world models via observation.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；通过观察构建世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential; open source crucial.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型至关重要；开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative world models; open source enables diversity.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型；开源促进多样性。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, not pixels; LLMs are dead end; objective-driven AI with planning is future.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，而非像素；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动、具备规划的 AI 是未来。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point; post-training and RSP gain importance.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点；后训练与负责任扩展策略愈发重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; misuse risks rise; open-source is a red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 进展呈指数级；滥用风险上升；开源是伪议题；企业级专注与安全目标一致。

dario.en: Exponential may end soon; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; economic disruption and inequality are key.
dario.zh: 2026 年：指数增长可能临近尾声；'天才之国'或在一至三年内出现；经济冲击与不平等成为焦点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; mechanistic interpretability is crucial; responsible scaling requires proactive measures.
dario.zh: 始终：安全与能力相辅相成；机制可解释性至关重要；负责任的扩展需主动施策。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，而非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key before superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；超级智能前需先遏制与对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制优先。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must build own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非职业。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 容错界面是机器学习产品的关键；坚持强烈观点但保持开放。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality, optimize for what matters.
gustav.zh: 没有唯一正确的组织模式；选择适合自己个性的，并优化最重要的事。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言获得控制权；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming over divide-and-conquer; AI should empower users, not addict.
gustav.zh: 采用同步协作而非分而治之；AI 应赋能用户而非让人上瘾。

satya.en: Private evals are the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; every company should hill-climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 私有评估是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；每家公司都应在前沿模型上进行爬山式优化。

satya.en: Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow as AI becomes more agentic.
satya.zh: 按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；随着 AI 变得更智能体式，消费定价将增长。

satya.en: The generalist role will see maximum returns in the agentic world, not specialists.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报，而非专才。

satya.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全和遏制对智能体至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并公开进行安全工作。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年：从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Focus on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：AI 治理应聚焦制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年：尽可能长期保持人类参与，以实现持久进步；未来并非注定。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling math AI; informal scaling alone is not viable.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，强调形式化验证对扩展数学 AI 至关重要，仅靠非形式化扩展不可行。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean is key.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，将自然语言锚定在 Lean 中是关键。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not a burden; it scales brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，将形式化验证视为性能提升而非负担，能扩展才华。

carinahong.en: Formal methods are necessary for superintelligence; informal systems alone cannot scale.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为形式化方法对超级智能必不可少，仅非形式化系统无法扩展。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型提升；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools enables solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，结合强化学习和工具的推理能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆押注并取得成功；大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute scaling; open source enables safety through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯扩大算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise customization, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升可达百倍，价值转向应用与企业定制，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI 机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise adaptation; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠垂直专业化与企业适配；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottleneck is organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local access to user tools; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于本地访问用户工具；技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；应聚焦能力与安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is user mindset: almost any problem can be given to AI; kids excel naturally.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大差距是用户心态：几乎所有问题都可交给 AI；孩子天然擅长。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; async interaction is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；异步交互是理想方式。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors; email is a source of truth.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误；电子邮件是事实来源。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批次大小是延迟与成本之间的权衡杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理经济学，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce this overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动也主导算力；脉动阵列减少了这种开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度（FP4）由于面积二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

jonyive.en: Design driven by curiosity and purpose, not profit; virtual tools can't replace in-person creative collaboration.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，强调设计应源于好奇心和使命感而非利润，虚拟工具无法替代面对面协作的创造力。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must retain soul and joy; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation; care in products is key.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，主张简约需保留灵魂与趣味，速度与质量可兼得，产品中的用心至关重要。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not ashes; EV enables new forms, not imitation.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，强调创新是设计之本，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动车应开创新形态而非模仿燃油车。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience: avoid fake engine sounds; physical controls over touchscreens for safety.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，主张用户体验要真实，避免虚假声浪；为安全起见，车内应优先物理按键而非触屏。

jonyive.en: Design should be purposeful, human, and joyful; collaboration with diverse talents yields breakthrough results.
jonyive.zh: 始终，设计应具有目的性、人性化和趣味性；与多元人才合作能带来突破性成果。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；关键在于解决智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 数据，而非算力或制造，是人形机器人最大的制约因素。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理对现实部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，旨在打造类似 iPhone 的时刻。

brettadcock.en: Robot hand parity with human hand is fundamental for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人手与人类手对齐是通用机器人的基础。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应相信直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建与交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers' value lies in judgment and ambiguity tolerance, not taste or process.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师的价值在于判断力与对模糊性的容忍，而非品味或流程。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 因行业投入而仍是主流；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT provides most gains, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 贡献大部分提升，DPO 和 RL 增添个性与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a key risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练最大突破；过度优化是关键风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍成立，但易得收益已尽；进步主要来自后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade, but lag 6-9 months behind closed models; Chinese labs excel in execution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长执行。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning is the winning approach for autonomous driving, outperforming hand-coded stacks.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习是自动驾驶的制胜方法，优于手工编码的堆栈。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了表征，支持人机交互，并有助于内省。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 内置传感器的消费级车辆在短期和中期内将超过机器人出租车。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; this is the decade of agents, not the year; vibe coding democratizes programming.
karpathy.zh: LLM 如同操作系统；这是智能体的十年而非一年；vibe coding 使编程民主化。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习需要更好的信用分配；合成数据会崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle coding; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source lag healthy.
karpathy.zh: 自十二月起我未再输入代码；智能体负责编程；瓶颈在于指挥技能；智能体优先工具和开源滞后是健康的。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索可防止过拟合，实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: From curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: robotics needs diverse data sources and a universal brain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心驱动探索，到 2026 年转向数据驱动的预训练，认为机器人需要多样数据源和通用大脑。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use videos, simulation, and real-world data for pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，明确机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，需利用视频、仿真和真实数据做预训练和后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it is a technical challenge, not just a business problem.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人主要挑战，是技术难题，不仅是商业问题。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization and scaling, from robot learning to universal brain, with emphasis on real-world applicability.
pathak.zh: 始终关注泛化和 Scaling，从机器人学习到通用大脑，强调现实世界适用性。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅强化学习就足够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key for interpretability; hiding it preserves value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是可解释性的关键；隐藏它可保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision; power concentration is top risk.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督方式；权力集中是最大风险。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival is key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存是初创企业的关键。

carlpei.en: Phones will evolve with generative UI and proactive agents; hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 手机将随生成式界面和主动智能体演进；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI is commoditizing; focus on applied AI and user experience, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 正在商品化；聚焦应用型 AI 和用户体验，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses, only brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 设计是关键差异化；智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能。

carlpei.en: Content creation and efficient marketing arbitrage are key advantages for challenger brands.
carlpei.zh: 内容创作和高效营销套利是挑战者品牌的关键优势。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; deep human evaluation is the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性；深度人工评估才是衡量模型进步的黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; no single model rules all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，导致 AI 多样化；没有单一模型能统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI risks omission and sycophancy; human judgment and safety are paramount.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 存在遗漏和谄媚风险；人类判断力和安全性至关重要。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software, ship daily; chat is MS-DOS, future UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张把模型当产品、像软件一样每日迭代；聊天界面只是 MS-DOS，未来 UI 会进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous frontier model process, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，坚持安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格流程，产品开发则尽可能加速。

turley.en: Retention is north star; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，以长期留存为北极星；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型需无缝产品化。

turley.en: Pricing evolves with tech; unlimited plans unsustainable; curiosity key skill in AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，指出定价随技术演变，无限套餐不可持续；好奇心是 AI 时代关键技能。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，我认为具身对 AI 落地至关重要，能减少幻觉；LLM 因缺乏具身体验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，我强调仿真对训练具身智能体的关键作用，可实现并行化和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，我认为机器人学的主要瓶颈是数据，仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，我提出物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱房间——是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest in embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，我认为系统二的推理进展顺利，但系统一的低级控制仍是具身 AI 最难的部分。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，而编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; economic impact limited by human management.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；经济影响受限于人类管理带宽。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; transformers are sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚信进展是指数级的；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang; focus shifts to orchestration and compute; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为存在能力过剩；重点转向编排和算力；世界模型对 AGI 并非关键。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并看好从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）作为通往 AGI 的路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education, but safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展优势，语言模型可革新本地语言教育，但 AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion in AI community as essential for building beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 社区的多样性和包容性对于构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths (video learning, generalist agents) to broader societal applications and safety challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频学习、通用智能体）转向 2026 年更广泛的社会应用和安全挑战，视角从技术扩展到社会。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需拥抱失败并简化问题，体现对 AI 人才素养的深化认识。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models can outperform larger ones with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于对互联网去偏；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能超越大模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner for rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，支持快速试错。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具以代码为源、可互操作；传统工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; specialists may be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；专才可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目可胜过经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同忽视早期互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应通过写代码建立同理心并加速交付，优先追求速度和熟悉感而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation, not just visual identity; invest early.
