henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，品牌被视为招聘和差异化的战略武器，而非仅视觉识别，需早期投入。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and ownership to grow capability.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆，赋予设计师自主权和所有权以提升能力。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化设计评审，偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动，流程应适应问题而非通用模板。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress, but benchmarks are poor proxies.
truell.zh: 最初，自然语言不会是编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作更好。缩放定律预测进展，但基准测试是糟糕的代理。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central. Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不非常有用；迭代的人机协作仍是核心。测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat. Taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 未来编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类主导。品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost. Every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是速度和成本。Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades. Senior engineers underrate AI, junior over-rely.
truell.zh: AI 转变将比互联网影响更大，需数十年。资深工程师低估 AI，初级工程师过度依赖。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data improves intelligence; neural nets are alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展提升智能；神经网络内部如同炼金术，难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; inference costs are low enough for task-specific models.
shazeer.zh: 开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距；推理成本足够低，无需为高价值领域定制模型。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products; coding enables self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: AGI 被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品；编码能力使 AI 自我加速。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are key. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐和鲁棒性是关键；机器学习博士是最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，应训练欺骗性模型作为‘模式生物’来研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化已侵蚀，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管变得必要。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年：自博弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号；强化学习需要分层推理来处理长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge is limiting; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识有局限；语言模型可迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on RL and learning-based approaches for robotics, emphasizing generality and transfer over hand-crafted solutions.
abbeel.zh: 始终：坚持强化学习和基于学习的方法，强调通用性和迁移，而非手工设计。

abbeel.en: Reliability benchmark (99.9%) for real-world robotics value; a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：现实世界机器人价值需达到 99.9%可靠性；单一网络可跨任务和末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Shift from emphasizing self-play and imitation to leveraging unsupervised learning and pre-trained models for efficiency and transfer.
abbeel.zh: 2018→2021：从强调自博弈和模仿学习，转向利用无监督学习和预训练模型提升效率与迁移能力。
